PC: Selected appropriate intervention(s) in a timely manner (Patient Care)
Appropriate and timely resuscitation of an unstable, critically ill patient, including adequate IV fluid delivery and timely implementation of medications needed to stabilize the patient.
Incorporate standard of care for acute coronary syndrome
MK: Correct interpretation of laboratory, clinical and hemodynamic data
Identify signs and symptoms suggestive of a patient suffering from a peri – operative MI
SBP: Communicate with cardiology consultant in a timely manner
ICS: Worked well with the team (Communication, Professionalism)
Shared decision making with constant re-appraisal of the situation along with open communication with nursing and other physicians involved in the caring of a critically ill patient.
Demonstrate an ability to anticipate subsequent complications and accurately communicate them to all involved care givers
PBLI: Evaluated and acknowledged their own performance and feedback (PBLI)
